purpose: Production cast and visual continuity registry. Not a runtime reader data file.
scope: All 18 human names in the v6 narration pronunciation list, plus Raven; four supporting recurring faces. Other minor contacts receive their own record before first illustration.
source_priority: Draft/v6/part1.md through part5.md for scene and appearance facts
Draft/v6/narration-guide.txt for canonical spellings and production identity aliases
source_notes: One-based line citations and chapter numbers refer to the current v6 part files. Excerpts identify the exact source text even if later edits move lines.
Older plans are thematic references; they do not override v6 identities, ages, or revised events.
A fact sourced from a later chapter may establish a stable appearance for production. It must not be exposed as an early biography or used to reveal future events.

reveal_policy.scene_cue_granularity: A chapter is the minimum guard. Within a chapter, reveal new faces, names and props only after the corresponding narration/text anchor.
reveal_policy.public_asset_labels: Use cue-local labels and spoiler-safe captions/alt text. Internal character IDs are not display names.
reveal_policy.future_variants: Do not carry later injuries, costume changes, younger photograph ages, allegiances, or fate into earlier scenes.
reveal_policy.codename_policy: Aliases marked internal_only_until_verified are production vocabulary. Never assume a narration-guide alias is already known to a listener.
reveal_policy.casting_policy: Facts and artistic choices are separate. Every new face is an original fictional actor, and all unprovided visual specifics remain provisional.

materials: Dark warm timber in lived-in human spaces

composition: Soft practical light and cool screen light
One clear story beat per image
Stable actor identity across camera angles
avoid: Holograms or futuristic costumes absent from narration
Generated text required to be exact
Symbols that imply an unrevealed alliance
Beauty retouching that changes age or facial geometry

generation_workflow: Select character ID and scene timeline/wardrobe variant.
Use generated base reference pixels and any active costume/location reference as image-generation references. A name or repeated prompt alone is insufficient.
Preserve face geometry, hairline, complexion, glasses and proportions. Change pose, expression, lighting and approved wardrobe only.
Review generated image beside model sheet and neighboring story images. Check stable actor likeness and scene-specific props.
Verify text-anchor reveal, accessible label and public filename before inclusion in reader runtime.
Record approved revisions with a new reference version; keep old references for continuity and do not silently redefine actors.
